params.name: key
params.description: Column identifier used in the sort query string. Required if `sortable`.

params.name: sortable
params.description: Whether the column can be sorted.

name: rows
description: Array of rows, each an array of cells.

params.name: sortValue
params.description: Value to sort on instead of the displayed text. Use for dates and amounts, where the display format does not sort correctly.

name: sort
description: `key` of the column currently sorted, so the server's sort state is reflected in `aria-sort`.

name: firstCellIsHeader
description: Render the first cell of each row as a row header.

name: captionClasses
description: Classes for the caption. Defaults to `govuk-table__caption--m`.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the table.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the table.
